**Founder & CEO at Cryptocurrencyteens**


Welcome to episode 25 of our Globe Interview Series. Today, we speak to Abigail Li, the founder and CEO of crypto educational platform for teenagers and Gen Z,[Cryptocurrencyteens](https://www.cryptocurrencyteens.com/) . Abigail is establishing her name as an expert in blockchain education and someone young people can rely on to learn about the expanding world of digital finance.


Even though Abigail is still a high school junior, she has created a niche by providing financial literacy to teens looking for answers to their cryptocurrency questions and wanting to satisfy their curiosity. In this conversation, Abigail talks to us about her journey into blockchain and crypto and why she started a blockchain/crypto educational platform that caters specifically to teenagers and Gen Z’s.


**Who is Abigail Li?**


Press enter or click to view image in full size


Abigail Li is a Singaporean-Taiwanese American junior student at the Hunter College High School in New York City. She discovered blockchain at a very young age and completed an internship with a crypto exchange which further advanced her knowledge, gave her first-hand industry experience, and sparked a drive to teach other young people like her.


Abigail is passionate about helping females, people of color, and low-income students interested in getting access to helpful knowledge about cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Digital Finance. For this reason, she started her crypto educational website, a podcast, and consistently uploads educational materials to her website to empower young people and low-income students to get access to free resources on financial wellness.


Abigail revealed that the many practical applications of blockchain are the driving force for her interest in the blockchain industry. She says, *“I did a research paper on how blockchain technology can be used to reduce poverty or increase financial inclusion in the world, relatable to teenagers.*


Cryptocurrencyteens has helped Abigail understand her place in the finance and business industries. She now knows the future jobs to pursue or areas she can focus on. Teaching and educating others about financial wellbeing is something Abigail is passionate about.


**What is Cryptocurrencyteens?**


Cryptocurrencyteens is an educational platform created to educate teens and Gen Z’s about cryptocurrency and blockchain. It engages them with easy-to-understand material regardless of their financial means, race, or background. Abigail founded Cryptocurrencyteens in 2020 to solve the dearth of reliable and trustworthy resources for financial literacy and cryptocurrency for teenagers like herself.


She discovered that the resources pushed around social media spaces like TikTok were highly unreliable, misleading, or unsuitable for her age group. They were usually information coming from influencers with selfish interests in projects and tokens produced by white males who did not consider women or minority groups in what they were providing.


**The Future of Cryptocurrencyteens**


Abigail is proud to lead the team at Cryptocurrencyteen. She will continue to help teenagers learn more about Cryptocurrency blockchain and hopefully improve their understanding of the financial industry and wellbeing.


She hopes Cryptocurrencyteens will become an educational hub for teens and young people looking to learn more about blockchain and be encouraged to move into this industry in the future and even pursue a college program at top schools.


Abigail is currently running a scholarship program supported by crypto exchanges, among other things. She’s also looking towards partnerships with other schools and organizations.
